meta.name: frontend-engineer
meta.description: Pro frontend engineering discipline. Enforces build-test-verify workflow for every web project. Never declare done until the site is built, tested, responsive, accessible, and visually verified in a real browser. Pairs with a deployment skill such as vercel-cli, where one is installed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 确保每个网页项目在交付前都通过构建、测试与真实浏览器验证
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是前端开发者,希望每个网页项目在交付前都得到系统性验证。
copy.tagline_en: Ensure every web project passes build, test, and real-browser verification before delivery
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a frontend developer wanting a systematic verification workflow before delivering web projects.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按“先读懂代码→写高质量代码→构建→浏览器截图验证→部署→线上验证”的顺序做前端任务,截不到图就不说“完成”。它还会检查控制台报错、布局溢出、可访问性等,并要求汇报截图和已知限制。
howto.when: 当你提出构建或修改网站、网页应用等前端任务时触发;它会把任务拆成构建-测试-验证流程,并在最后用浏览器截图验收。

say.text: 帮我新建一个 Vite 项目,用 TypeScript,跑通构建并截图。
say.note: 会按流程搭建并输出截图。

say.text: 审查这几个组件的代码,指出 TypeScript 和反模式问题。
say.note: 会按规范逐条检查并汇报。

say.text: 打包没有,在真实浏览器里验证页面并截图。
say.note: 会启动浏览器验证桌面和移动端。

howto.what_en: Enforces a build-test-verify cycle for web projects. Requires real-browser screenshot proof before declaring done. Checks console errors, layout, accessibility, and reports known limits.
howto.when_en: Activates on any web project task, e.g., building or modifying sites or apps. Always applies the full workflow and screenshot-based acceptance before completion.

say_en.text: Create a new Vite project with TypeScript, run the build, and take screenshots.
say_en.note: Follows the workflow and outputs screenshots.

say_en.text: Review these components and flag TypeScript or anti-pattern issues.
say_en.note: Checks code against the rules and reports.

say_en.text: Is the build ready? Verify the page in a real browser and screenshot it.
say_en.note: Starts browser, checks desktop and mobile views.
